exposure: Protocols for neonatal referral to the pediatrician for six common indications: large for gestational age/macrosomia, small for gestational age/fetal growth restriction, meconium-stained amniotic fluid, vacuum extraction, forceps extraction, and cesarean birth.
small for gestational age/fetal growth restriction
outcome: Variation in recommendations for type of referral
Variation in recommendations for screening/diagnostic tests
cohort: Obstetric and neonatal departments of all Dutch hospitals
finding: This study found considerable variation in the content of obstetric and neonatal protocols for six common indications for neonatal referral to the pediatrician between regions, between neonatal and obstetrics departments, and within neonatal and obstetrics departments in Dutch hospitals.
